prior_tool_observation_count.description: Number of tool observation steps available in the history strictly prior to this gate point.
prior_tool_observation_count.unavailable_representation: 0 if no prior tool observations exist
prior_tool_observation_count.monotonicity: Higher means more prior tool context is available.
prior_tool_observation_count.limitations: Does not measure content relevance, only step volume.

distinct_prior_tool_source_count.inputs: Tool names recorded in prior tool execution results
distinct_prior_tool_source_count.description: Number of distinct tool names that produced prior observations in the causal prefix.
distinct_prior_tool_source_count.unavailable_representation: 0 if no prior tool observations exist
distinct_prior_tool_source_count.monotonicity: Higher means more diverse prior data sources.
distinct_prior_tool_source_count.limitations: Repeated calls to the same tool count as 1 source.

prior_observation_char_length.inputs: Raw text content of prior tool observation steps
prior_observation_char_length.description: Total character length of all prior tool observation strings available to the monitor.
prior_observation_char_length.unavailable_representation: 0 if no prior tool observations exist
prior_observation_char_length.monotonicity: Higher indicates larger volume of untrusted environment text in prompt history.
prior_observation_char_length.limitations: Character count includes whitespace and formatting markup.

prior_observation_token_count.inputs: Normalized, stopword-filtered tokens from prior tool observations
prior_observation_token_count.description: Total count of meaningful lexical tokens across all prior tool observations.
prior_observation_token_count.unavailable_representation: 0 if no prior tool observations exist
prior_observation_token_count.monotonicity: Higher indicates more lexical material available to copy or be tainted by.
prior_observation_token_count.limitations: Dependent on whitespace/punctuation tokenizer and stopword list.

proposed_argument_char_length.inputs: Values of proposed_arguments in the current tool call
proposed_argument_char_length.description: Total character length of all serialized string, numeric, and collection values in proposed arguments.
proposed_argument_char_length.monotonicity: Higher indicates longer proposed payloads in tool parameters.
proposed_argument_char_length.limitations: Argument keys are excluded from length.

proposed_argument_token_count.inputs: Normalized, stopword-filtered tokens from proposed argument values
proposed_argument_token_count.description: Total count of unique meaningful lexical tokens extracted from proposed argument values.
proposed_argument_token_count.unavailable_representation: 0 if proposed arguments are empty or contain only stopwords
proposed_argument_token_count.monotonicity: Higher indicates richer vocabulary in proposed call arguments.
proposed_argument_token_count.limitations: Duplicate tokens within arguments are deduplicated for lexical overlap ratios.

has_non_empty_arguments.description: Whether the proposed tool call contains at least one non-empty argument value.
has_non_empty_arguments.unavailable_representation: False if arguments dictionary is empty or all values are empty
has_non_empty_arguments.limitations: Calls without arguments (e.g. list_files()) are legitimately False.

overlapping_argument_token_count.inputs: Proposed argument tokens and prior tool observation tokens
overlapping_argument_token_count.description: Number of unique proposed argument tokens that appear verbatim in prior tool observations.
overlapping_argument_token_count.unavailable_representation: 0 if arguments empty or no prior observations exist
overlapping_argument_token_count.monotonicity: Higher indicates greater lexical provenance tracing back to tool outputs.
overlapping_argument_token_count.limitations: Legitimate copying of filenames or dates also increases this count.

argument_token_overlap_fraction.description: Ratio of proposed argument tokens that were observed in prior tool outputs.
argument_token_overlap_fraction.unavailable_representation: 0.0 if proposed arguments have 0 non-stopword tokens
argument_token_overlap_fraction.monotonicity: Higher indicates higher proportion of argument content sourced from observations.
argument_token_overlap_fraction.limitations: Benign tool calls copying query parameters may naturally have 1.0 overlap.

max_single_observation_token_overlap.description: Maximum token overlap fraction between the proposed arguments and any single prior tool observation.
max_single_observation_token_overlap.unavailable_representation: 0.0 if no prior tool observations exist or arguments are empty
max_single_observation_token_overlap.monotonicity: Higher indicates concentration of argument tokens originating from a single source step.

matching_argument_substring_count.inputs: Argument string values and prior tool observation text
matching_argument_substring_count.description: Count of argument string segments (length >= 4 chars, non-stopword) that occur verbatim as substrings in prior tool text.
matching_argument_substring_count.unavailable_representation: 0 if no arguments or prior observations exist
matching_argument_substring_count.monotonicity: Higher indicates exact phrase copying from prior outputs.
matching_argument_substring_count.limitations: Short common words are filtered out to prevent noise.

is_tool_name_known.inputs: proposed_tool_name checked against registered tool schema registry
is_tool_name_known.description: Whether the proposed tool name is recognized in the official tool schema registry.
is_tool_name_known.unavailable_representation: False if tool is not registered
is_tool_name_known.limitations: Hallucinated or misspelled tool names will be False.

is_schema_available.description: Whether parameter metadata and type definitions were successfully resolved for this tool.
is_schema_available.unavailable_representation: False if schema could not be loaded
is_schema_available.monotonicity: True indicates full structural validation is active.
is_schema_available.limitations: If False, schema-dependent counts default to conservative indicators.

is_call_id_valid.description: Whether the proposed tool call carries a non-empty string identifier.
is_call_id_valid.unavailable_representation: False if call_id is None, empty, or whitespace
is_call_id_valid.monotonicity: True indicates compliant tool call framing.
is_call_id_valid.limitations: Does not verify runtime uniqueness across sessions.

provided_argument_count.description: Total number of argument keys passed in the proposed tool call.
provided_argument_count.limitations: Includes both valid and invalid argument keys.

declared_property_count.description: Number of parameters declared in the tool's official JSON schema.
declared_property_count.limitations: Fixed property of the tool schema, independent of call.

required_argument_count.description: Number of parameters marked as mandatory in the tool's official JSON schema.
required_argument_count.limitations: Fixed property of the tool schema.

missing_required_argument_count.inputs: Declared required properties vs proposed argument keys
missing_required_argument_count.description: Number of required parameters that were omitted from the proposed call.
missing_required_argument_count.unavailable_representation: 0 if schema unavailable or none missing
missing_required_argument_count.monotonicity: Higher indicates greater schema violation / omission error.
missing_required_argument_count.limitations: Omission can be caused by benign model mistakes as well as attacks.

has_missing_required_arguments.description: Whether at least one required argument is missing from the proposed call.
has_missing_required_arguments.unavailable_representation: False if none missing or schema unavailable

unexpected_argument_key_count.inputs: Proposed argument keys not present in declared schema properties
unexpected_argument_key_count.description: Number of extraneous argument keys passed that are not declared in the tool schema.
unexpected_argument_key_count.unavailable_representation: 0 if schema unavailable or no extra keys
unexpected_argument_key_count.monotonicity: Higher indicates greater hallucination or schema deviation.
unexpected_argument_key_count.limitations: Tools with freeform kwargs are not used in AgentDojo workspace.

has_unexpected_argument_keys.description: Whether any extraneous argument keys were provided.
has_unexpected_argument_keys.unavailable_representation: False if no extra keys or schema unavailable
has_unexpected_argument_keys.monotonicity: True indicates invalid argument names passed.

type_mismatch_count.inputs: Proposed argument values validated against declared schema types
type_mismatch_count.description: Number of provided arguments whose runtime Python type violates the declared JSON schema type.
type_mismatch_count.unavailable_representation: 0 if schema unavailable or no mismatches
type_mismatch_count.limitations: Validates basic JSON Schema types: string, integer, number, boolean, array, object, null.

has_type_mismatches.description: Whether any argument value has a type mismatch with the tool schema.
has_type_mismatches.unavailable_representation: False if no type mismatches or schema unavailable
has_type_mismatches.monotonicity: True indicates type error in call parameters.

schema_conformant_argument_count.inputs: Provided arguments matching declared properties and types
schema_conformant_argument_count.description: Number of provided arguments that are recognized by the schema and have valid types.
schema_conformant_argument_count.unavailable_representation: 0 if schema unavailable or no conformant arguments
schema_conformant_argument_count.monotonicity: Higher indicates more well-formed parameters passed.
schema_conformant_argument_count.limitations: Does not guarantee semantic correctness of argument contents.

is_completely_schema_conformant.inputs: Combination of tool known, schema available, 0 missing, 0 unexpected, 0 type mismatches
is_completely_schema_conformant.description: Whether the proposed tool call fully satisfies the tool's declared schema with zero structural deviations.
is_completely_schema_conformant.unavailable_representation: False if tool is unknown or schema unavailable
is_completely_schema_conformant.limitations: A structurally valid call may still be malicious (e.g. exfiltration email).
